name: GBIF Global Biodiversity Information Facility Species Occurrences
description: The Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) is an international open data infrastructure funded by governments worldwide to provide anyone, anywhere, open access to data about all types of life on Earth. The GBIF Occurrence index harmonizes more than 2.8 billion species occurrence records from over 2,000 publishing institutions across 150 countries. Integrating museum specimens, camera trap images, environmental DNA, citizen science records, and ecological transects, GBIF indexes species occurrences tagged with standardized Darwin Core geospatial, taxonomic, and temporal metadata.
